description: This file defines the ReportHelper utility class for the marketing report module in the OFBiz framework. It includes a method to calculate conversion rates based on visit and order data.

classes.name: ReportHelper
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods to assist with marketing reporting calculations.

methods.name: calcConversionRates
methods.description: Calculates conversion rates based on visits and orders lists filtered by a specified key field, returning a list of maps with reporting metrics.
